name: Offline Translate
author: Lekonidus
description: Translate ~115 languages to English, fully offline (NLLB-200). Install with `omarchy plugin add`, then click the bar icon once to run the one-time setup (1.4 GB download). Copying non-English text shows a translation popup; the model loads only while in use.

barWidget.description: Open the translator; shows when the model is loaded
